reason: The vertical internal-door path used an implicit fixed 0.10 m/s exchange although zone temperatures and atmospheric pressure were available. It now uses the centered-neutral-plane two-opening buoyancy equation documented in NIST TN 1887r1. The Extended workbook also supplies n2_attic_door_pos, which the mapper previously ignored; it is now mapped as a dynamic control. These changes follow registered model and source contracts and were not selected by fitting measured temperatures.
unchanged_from_v1_3: window, kitchen-door, and blind source schedules

corrected_airflow_mapping.vertical_internal_doors: NIST CONTAM two-opening centered-neutral-plane buoyancy exchange using current zone temperatures, timestep atmospheric pressure, explicit opening area and height, and discharge coefficient 0.78
corrected_airflow_mapping.attic_trap_door_state: n2_attic_door_pos is mapped at every Extended timestep
corrected_airflow_mapping.horizontal_trap_door_physics: remains an explicit prescribed_velocity compatibility model at 0.10 m/s because NexusEP has no whole-building pressure solve or verified horizontal-opening correlation

scientific_label: Results under v1.4 are post-unsealing corrected diagnostics. The immutable first holdout result remains published and rejected. This amendment cannot restore a blind-validation claim.
